biography.1: Over the past five years, I have worked as a front-end developer across various industries, collaborating with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into intuitive, accessible, and consistent user interfaces.
biography.2: This experience broadened my understanding of how strategy, design, and technology can work together to create clearer, more scalable, people-centered products.
biography.3: Today, I focus my professional development on UX, design systems, and front-end development, aiming to create experiences that reduce complexity and deliver value to both users and businesses.

description.1: I worked across several product squads, focusing on usability, performance, and component-based development. I developed interfaces with React and Next.js using TypeScript and Styled-components, implemented automated tests with Jest and React Testing Library, contributed to the Design System with Storybook, and integrated REST and GraphQL (Apollo) APIs. I also focused on performance.
description.2: I used Redux Toolkit for global state management.
description.3: Results: Reduced the time customers spent on manual tasks by 70%, increasing efficiency and restoring the company's reputation.

mercadocar.description: I started on the UI/UX team, conducting user research and designing e-commerce flows that increased the conversion rate by 30%. I worked as a front-end developer with JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS/SASS, jQuery, and Webpack, implementing mobile-first responsive design and integrating REST APIs.
